name: Celestia
source:
Iluna (renameable) is the newest moon of the Lunefille system. On behalf of her planet, starless in the darkness, she seeks to find a celestial partner who will rule by her side... and in her heart. 

Follow this moon's journey into traditional love alongside a sun, tragic love with a black hole or forbidden love with a meteor in this regency style sci-fi fantasy delight.

[Edited from [url=https://chouette.itch.io/celestia]Itch.io[/url]]
